name: NVC VHDL Compiler
description: Installs NVC, an open source VHDL compiler and simulator (https://github.com/nickg/nvc).

installMethod.description: 'deb' uses the prebuilt Ubuntu package (amd64, Ubuntu 22.04/24.04/26.04 only), 'source' builds from the release tarball, 'auto' prefers 'deb' and falls back to 'source'.

libraries.description: Space or comma separated list of third-party VHDL libraries to pre-compile via 'nvc --install' (e.g. 'osvvm uvvm').
